name: Halftone
author: Ambrotype
description: The photo as print: two-ink dither dots (Game Boy, newsprint), concentric rings or straight lines whose thickness follows the shadows, or psychedelic rainbow bands with an emboss relief. It reads the whole photo at once.

params.name: style
params.label: Style
params.description: Dither: random dots in two inks. Rings and Lines: a line screen, thick in shadows. Rainbow: false colour bands.

params.name: ink
params.label: Ink
params.description: The dark and light ink. Rainbow ignores it.

params.name: size
params.label: Size
params.description: Dot or line spacing, in percent of the photo's short side.

params.name: contrast
params.label: Contrast
params.description: Contrast of the brightness the effect reads.

params.name: fringe
params.label: Colour fringe
params.description: Rings and Lines: each colour's screen sits a little apart, so edges show red, green and blue.

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Lines: the direction of the lines, in degrees.

params.name: x
params.label: Centre across
params.description: Rings: where the rings are centred.

params.name: y
params.label: Centre down
params.description: Rings: where the rings are centred.

params.name: bands
params.label: Bands
params.description: Rainbow: how many times the colours cycle from black to white.

params.name: strength
params.label: Strength
params.description: How much of the effect is mixed over the original.
